company.shortDescription: The NOMADD is The NO-water Mechanical Automated Dusting Device.
company.description:
The NOMADD is The NO-water Mechanical Automated Dusting Device.
It was developed at the King Abdullah University for Science and Technology, (KAUST) near Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

productsAndServices.description: A fully automated, waterless robotic system designed to clean solar panel arrays in desert environments without damaging panels.
productsAndServices.name: NOMADD Robotic Solar Panel Cleaning System

productsAndServices.description: A tracker-compatible robotic cleaning unit with an 8-wheel-drive chassis designed for flexible movement and dust removal on solar arrays.
productsAndServices.name: NOMADD 1P Edge Runner

productsAndServices.description: A versatile robotic cleaning system compatible with both fixed tilt and tracker solar arrays, designed for automated dust removal.
productsAndServices.name: NOMADD 2P Edge Runner

productsAndServices.description: A waterless robotic cleaning system designed to operate on rails attached to rooftop solar panel mounting structures, resistant to high winds.
productsAndServices.name: NOMADD Rooftop Installation Cleaning System

productsAndServices.description: Provision of a secure desert testing environment, professional data collection, analysis, and fully installed NOMADD cleaning systems for field trials.
productsAndServices.name: NOMADD Secure Desert Test Area and Data Services
